blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in world models have enabled increasingly realistic visual synthesis. However, these generated environments remain largely silent. Bringing sound to world models poses three core challenges: real-time generation to keep pace with interactive video streams, interactive control to respond to mid-stream sound instructions, and spatially aligned stereo to reflect scene geometry and camera motion. To address these demands, we introduce WorldSonus, an interactive video-to-audio framework designed for real-time spatial sound synthesis in world models. For real-time generation, WorldSonus employs a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that synthesizes audio chunks at a low real-time factor (RTF) of 0.41 0.41 . For interactive control, we incorporate an audio-centric captioning pipeline with chunk-indexed prompt scheduling, enabling dynamic manipulation of sound events during generation. For spatial alignment, we leverage high-quality stereo supervision curated from diverse stereo and ambisonic data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while tailored for world models, WorldSonus generalizes effectively to open-domain video-to-audio benchmarks, matching or outperforming state-of-the-art bidirectional models in both acoustic quality and spatial alignment. Project page: https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/ .
blocks.zh: 最近世界模型的进步使得视觉合成变得日益现实。 然而,这些产生的环境基本上保持沉默。 将声音带入世界模型提出了三个核心挑战:实时生成以跟上交互式视频流,交互控制以响应中流音指令,空间对接立体以反映场景几何和相机运动. 为应对这些需要,我们引入了WorldSonus,这是一个交互式的视频到音频框架,旨在为世界模型中的实时空间声音合成而设计. 对于实时生成,WorldSonus采用了流式因子自递式扩散架构,以0.410.41的低实时因子(RTF)合成音频块. 为了进行互动控制,我们采用了以音频为中心的标题管道,并采用块索引的即时排出,从而能够在生成期间动态地操纵声音事件。 在空间对接方面,我们利用来自各种立体声和声波数据的高质量立体声监督。 广泛的实验表明,WorldSonus虽然适合世界模型,但能有效地实现开放域的视频对音频基准,在声学质量和空间对接方面匹配或优于最先进的双向模型。 项目网页:https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/ 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in video generation ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Team, 2025b ) have accelerated the development of generative world models ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025b ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . While these models dynamically synthesize visual environments in response to user actions, the resulting virtual worlds remain predominantly silent. Bringing realistic sound to interactive world models requires audio that seamlessly tracks an evolving visual stream, maintains camera-aligned spatial balance under dynamic viewpoints, and immediately responds to updated text instructions during an ongoing session.
blocks.zh: 近期在视频生成方面的进步(王等,2025;蔡等,2025;哈可亨等,2025;孔等,2024;杨等,2025;Team,2025b)加快了基因世界模型的发展(瓦列夫斯基等,2025;贺等,2025;孙等,2025b;高等,2026. 虽然这些模型响应用户行动而动态地合成了视觉环境,但由此产生的虚拟世界仍然以沉默为主. 将现实的声音带入互动世界模型需要音频能够无缝地跟踪一个不断发展的视觉流,在动态视角下保持相机相通的空间平衡,并在进行中的会话中立即响应更新的文本指令.

blocks.en: Existing approaches to world-model sound generation fall into two primary categories. The first direction builds upon joint audiovisual foundation models ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) extended to long-horizon streaming ( Duan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Su et al., 2026 ) . However, coupling audio synthesis directly to the visual backbone prevents these systems from serving as standalone audio modules for visual-only world models, while causal distillation or long autoregressive (AR) rollouts often accumulate error over time. The second direction employs dedicated video-to-audio (V2A) generators, allowing modular integration with external visual engines. Yet current streaming V2A models remain constrained: V-AURA ( Viertola et al., 2025 ) uses bidirectional visual windows and outputs mono audio. SoundReactor ( Saito et al., 2025 ) achieves real-time stereo generation but lacks mid-stream text controllability. SwanSphere ( Lei et al., 2026 ) focuses on panoramic video and first-order ambisonics (FOA) soundfields rather than standard perspective streams. Consequently, there remains a need for a modular V2A framework that simultaneously delivers causal real-time generation, mid-stream interactive text control, and spatially aligned perspective stereo audio.
blocks.zh: 现有的世界模范声音生成方法分为两大类。 第一个方向建立在联合视听基础模型(HaCohen等,2026年)上,扩展到长相流线(Duan等,2026年;Zhang等,2026a;Su等,2026年). 然而,将音频合成直接与视觉主干线相接,使得这些系统无法作为仅可视化的世界模型的独立音频模块,而因果衍射或长自相递减(AR)推出往往会随着时间的推移而累积出出错. 第二方向采用专用的视频到音频(V2A)发电机,允许与外视引擎进行模块化集成. 然而,目前的流出V2A模型仍然受到限制:V-AURA(Viertola等,2025年)使用双向视觉窗口和输出单声道. SoundReactor(Saito等,2025年)实现实时立体声生成,但缺乏中流文本可控性. SwanSphere(Lei等,2026年)专注于全景视频和一阶的ambisonics(FOA)音域而非标准视角流. 因此,仍然需要一个模块化的V2A框架,同时提供因果实时生成、中流互动文本控制以及空间对齐的视角立体声。

blocks.en: We present WorldSonus, a modular V2A framework designed to endow generative world models with real-time, controllable stereo audio. For real-time generation , WorldSonus employs a streaming AR-diffusion architecture emitting 100 100 ms audio chunks conditioned only on past and current visual context. A bounded persistent state ensures constant memory usage and compute cost as the stream expands. For interactive control , training on time-varying prompt schedules combined with chunk-level cross-attention enables users to dynamically revise text instructions for on-screen or off-screen sounds without session resets or past-frame recomputation. For spatially aligned stereo , we use clear-stereo clips and convert panoramic FOA data into camera-aligned stereo supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍WorldSonus,一个模块化的V2A框架,旨在将基因世界模型与实时,可控的立体声. WorldSonus使用流线式的AR-difusion架构, 受限的持久性状态保证了内存的不断使用并随着流的扩展而计算出成本. 对于交互控制,关于时间变化的即时时刻表的培训与块级的交叉注意相结合,使用户能够动态地修改屏幕上或屏幕外声音的文字说明,而无需重新编辑会话或重新计算。 对于空间对齐的立体,我们使用清晰的立体片段,并将全景FOA数据转换为相机对齐的立体监督.

blocks.en: Generating precise audiovisual alignment within causal contexts introduces unique challenges, as future visual frames are unavailable. To enforce temporal synchronization under limited lookahead, we introduce two-timescale visual conditioning and ShiftNCE. Chunk-level visual summaries guide the AR backbone to maintain semantic continuity, while frame-aligned local tokens condition the flow head with fine-grained spatial and temporal cues. To refine event timing without inference cost, ShiftNCE trains the AR state using a contrastive objective supervised by a frozen synchronization expert, eliminating ambiguous temporal negatives during training.
blocks.zh: 在因果背景下产生准确的视听配合带来了独特的挑战,因为未来的视觉框架是不存在的。 为了在有限的外观前行下执行时间同步,我们引入了双倍规模的视觉取景和ShiftNCE. Chunk-level可视摘要引导AR主干线保持语义连续性,而帧对接的本地活符则以精细的空间和时间提示来给流头作条件. 为了在不产生推论成本的情况下改进活动时间,ShiftNCE使用由冷冻同步专家监督的对比目标来训练AR状态,消除了训练期间模棱两可的时间负数.

blocks.en: Experiments demonstrate that despite causal operation, WorldSonus matches or exceeds state-of-the-art offline bidirectional V2A baselines across both open-domain VGGSound ( Chen et al., 2020 ) videos and our Interactive benchmark, which comprises gameplay and real-world footage. WorldSonus achieves VGGish FAD ( Hershey et al., 2017 ; Kilgour et al., 2019 ) scores of 1.73 1.73 on 5 5 s clear-stereo VGGSound ( Chen et al., 2020 ) clips and 2.03 2.03 on 30 30 s interactive videos, with an execution latency of 41.2 41.2 ms per 100 100 ms audio chunk (real-time factor, RTF = 0.41 \mathrm{RTF}=0.41 ) on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU.
blocks.zh: 实验证明,尽管有因果操作,WorldSonus仍然匹配或超过最新水平的离线双向V2A基线,既跨越了开放域的VGGSound(Chen等,2020年)视频,也跨越了我们的互动基准,包含游戏和现实世界的镜头. 世界 索努斯实现VGGish FAD(Hershey等,2017;Kilgour等,2019)在5 s clear-stereo VGGSound(Chen等,2020)片段上得分1.73分,在30 s 交互式视频上得分2.03 2.03分,每100 ms音频块(实时因子,RTF=0.41\mathrm{RTF}=0.41)在单 NVIDIA H100 GPU上得分.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are threefold: • Real-time, interactive stereo generation. We introduce WorldSonus, a modular V2A framework that unifies real-time causal generation, mid-stream prompt responsiveness, and camera-aligned stereo synthesis for interactive world models. • Causal audiovisual synchronization. We propose two-timescale visual conditioning and a training-only ShiftNCE distillation objective to maintain temporal synchronization under causal streaming without adding runtime latency. • State-of-the-art performance. Extensive evaluations show that WorldSonus achieves competitive or superior acoustic quality and stereo balance compared with offline bidirectional baselines, with counterfactual tests confirming robust interactive control.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献有三: ——实时互动立体声发电. 我们引入了WorldSonus,一个模块化的V2A框架,将实时因果生成,中流即时反应,相机相接的立体合成用于互动世界模型. • 因果视听同步。 我们提议采用两次规模的可视化和只培训的ShiftNCE蒸馏目标,在因果流下保持时间同步,而不会增加运行时间延迟。 • 最新业绩。 广泛的评价表明,与离线双向基线相比,WorldSonus实现了有竞争力或优越的声学质量和立体声平衡,反事实测试证实了强大的交互控制.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Bidirectional video-to-audio (V2A) synthesis has evolved from text-to-audio latent diffusion models ( Liu et al., 2023a ) and early V2A diffusion networks ( Luo et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) to time-aligned models and rectified flow architectures ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ) , improving semantic and temporal fidelity through audio-visual pretraining and explicit synchronization features. Recent models such as AudioX ( Tian et al., 2025 ) , ThinkSound ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , and PrismAudio ( Liu et al., 2025b ) render stereo via flow matching and reward alignment. AC-Foley ( Fang et al., 2026 ) adds reference-audio conditioning, while Omni2Sound ( Dai et al., 2026 ) investigates video-text-to-audio diffusion across modality combinations. Meanwhile, spatial audio generation has advanced from diffusion-based binaural synthesis ( Leng et al., 2022 ) toward object-aware stereo and ambisonics ( Karchkhadze et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025c ) . However, these approaches require full-clip visual context and do not support streaming video input or dynamic control within a persistent causal session.

blocks.zh: 3 世界之声

blocks.en: WorldSonus synthesizes real-time stereo audio from streaming video and dynamic prompts via chunk-wise causal AR generation (Figure 1 ). It couples a bounded recurrent memory with multi-scale visual conditioning and contrastive temporal alignment.

blocks.en: 3.2 Autoregressive Diffusion
blocks.zh: 3.2 自动递减扩散

blocks.en: To balance long-range semantic continuity with high-fidelity continuous generation, we adopt a chunked AR-diffusion framework ( Li et al., 2024 ; Saito et al., 2025 ; Lei et al., 2026 ) . At each step, a decoder-only Transformer processes two chunk-aggregated tokens (one from the previous audio chunk and one from the current video chunk) to maintain session state. Trained with a causal sliding-window attention mask, the model deploys a fixed-capacity Ring-KV cache over context window W W (a circular buffer overwriting the oldest slots in place). This ensures bounded memory while matching the context-window policy between training and inference.
blocks.zh: 为了平衡远距离语义连续性和高纯度连续生成,我们采用了一个块状的AR-difusion框架(Li等,2024;Saito等,2025;Lei等,2026)。 在每一步,一个解码器唯一的变形器会处理两个块组合的符号(一个来自上一个音频块,一个来自当前视频块)来维持会话状态. 该模型以因果滑动-窗口注意口罩来训练,在上下文窗口WW(一个循环缓冲器来覆盖所设置的最古老的插槽)上部署固定容量的Ring-KV缓存. 这既能确保有限度的内存,又能配合培训和推断之间的上下文窗口政策。

blocks.en: The resulting AR hidden state 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} conditions a compact flow head, which denoises the three latent frames of chunk t t using a rectified-flow objective ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023b ) . The flow head attends bidirectionally inside the current chunk, without access to frames of future blocks, and it reads the frame-aligned visual tokens of Section 3.3 as finer-grained spatial and temporal evidence. Appendix A gives the remaining network details.

blocks.en: To reconcile long-horizon semantic continuity in the bounded AR backbone with precise acoustic rendering in the flow head, we decouple visual conditioning into two complementary timescales: chunk-level semantics and frame-aligned local features . For each chunk (spanning three frames), a frozen DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) encoder maps video frames into spatial patch grids 𝐆 n \mathbf{G}_{n} . Mixed-aspect inputs are assigned to resolution buckets and resized without stretching at a fixed pixel budget. To capture motion cues, each grid is concatenated with its temporal difference Δ ​ 𝐆 n = 𝐆 n − 𝐆 n − 1 \Delta\mathbf{G}_{n}=\mathbf{G}_{n}-\mathbf{G}_{n-1} ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . A learned query then aggregates each frame’s spatial grid into a single feature token, yielding three frame tokens per chunk.

These frame tokens are then processed into the two target timescales:
For chunk-level semantics , a learned summary query aggregates the three frame tokens into a single chunk-level visual token, which is routed to the AR backbone to maintain a compact footprint.
For frame-aligned local features , the three refined frame tokens bypass the AR backbone to condition the flow head directly.
Our dual-path architecture provides the flow head with frame-aligned visual tokens without further chunk-level aggregation, which is essential for preserving the temporal granularity of individual video frames.

blocks.en: 3.4 Interactive Prompt Control
blocks.zh: 3.4 互动快速控制

blocks.en: To support interactive control during streaming, we introduce an in-place prompt control mechanism that allows text instructions to be updated mid-stream.
blocks.zh: 为了在流出时支持交互控制,我们引入了现场即时控制机制,允许文本指令被更新为中流.

blocks.en: Given a sound instruction, a T5Gemma 2 ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) text encoder and compressor project it into a compact token set that conditions the AR backbone via cross-attention, which is cached across streaming steps. When an instruction updates during streaming, the system performs an in-place replacement of the cross-attention cache at the nearest chunk boundary, preserving the Ring-KV cache and existing visual and audio states. To train the model for these dynamic transitions, we incorporate time-varying prompt schedules including mid-sequence instruction switches and drops. This enables seamless steering in a persistent causal session.

blocks.en:
Our dataset contains 1,465 1{,}465 hours of audio, including 999 999 hours of paired stereo video-audio data and 466 466 hours of audio-only data. The video-audio subset uses open-source datasets including VGGSound ( Chen et al., 2020 ) , AudioSet ( Gemmeke et al., 2017 ) , Kinetics-700 ( Carreira et al., 2019 ) , and HD-EPIC ( Perrett et al., 2025 ) to cover a wide range of acoustic events. To support audio generation for interactive world models, we collect additional standard stereo video with clear camera motion and dynamic objects. We also incorporate panoramic recordings from the existing Sphere360 ( Liu et al., 2025c ) and YT-AmbiGen ( Kim et al., 2025 ) datasets. For panoramic clips, we estimate horizontal sound directions from the acoustic energy field to sample perspective visual crops and render view-aligned stereo audio.
The audio-only subset includes AudioCaps ( Kim et al., 2019 ) and isolated audio tracks from weakly-aligned video clips, where the visual content is not aligned with the audio, but the soundtrack retains high-quality acoustic events.

blocks.en: We evaluate mainly on five test splits: two clear-stereo VGGSound ( Chen et al., 2020 ) splits ( 5 5 s and 10 10 s; 4,096 4{,}096 clips each) and three splits comprising interactive gameplay and real-world footage with dynamic camera motion ( 5 5 s and 10 10 s, with 4,096 4{,}096 clips each; 30 30 s, with 1,024 1{,}024 clips). blocks.en: For acoustic fidelity , we report Fréchet distances in VGGish ( Hershey et al., 2017 ) (FAD ( Kilgour et al., 2019 ) ), PaSST ( Koutini et al., 2022 ) (FD P ), and OpenL3 ( Cramer et al., 2019 ) (FD O ) feature spaces, together with PaSST-based KL divergence (KL P ). blocks.en: 5.3 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 主要成果

blocks.en: We conduct quantitative comparisons across all five held-out test splits. As shown in Table 1 , WorldSonus achieves competitive or superior acoustic quality (FAD, FD P , and KL P ) compared to bidirectional models on both VGGSound and interactive video datasets, despite using only visual frames from past and current chunks. Compared with the streaming baseline V-AURA, WorldSonus achieves lower distributional divergence and stronger audiovisual alignment while running at a much finer temporal resolution ( 100 100 ms vs. 640 640 ms), synthesized in just 41.2 41.2 ms per chunk on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU ( RTF = 0.41 \mathrm{RTF}=0.41 ) to comfortably satisfy real-time streaming requirements. Together, these results demonstrate that bounded-memory causal generation can combine competitive audio quality with real-time synthesis across the evaluated 5 5 – 30 30 s durations.

blocks.en: Temporal alignment objective. To investigate whether the proposed ShiftNCE objective explicitly drives fine-grained synchronization, and whether external temporal representations can replace it, we compare our default model against a variant trained without ShiftNCE and another incorporating direct features from a 640 640 ms causal Synchformer ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) window. As shown in Table 7 , removing ShiftNCE degrades DeSync from 0.831 0.831 to 1.067 1.067 , while direct feature injection yields worse timing and acoustic quality, possibly reflecting a mismatch between its 640 640 ms feature window and our 100 100 ms streaming chunks. These results confirm that ShiftNCE provides the necessary temporal supervision to sharpen alignment without requiring additional sync encoders or inference overhead.

blocks.en: Two-timescale visual conditioning. To evaluate the role of feeding direct frame-level visual features to the flow head, we compare our model with a variant that removes this shortcut path and passes visual information only through the autoregressive state. As shown in Table 7 , removing the direct visual connection leads to a severe degradation in audio quality, with FAD increasing from 2.42 2.42 to 15.82 15.82 . This confirms that in our streaming design, combining direct frame-level visual inputs with higher-level autoregressive context is essential for generating clear and synchronized audio.

blocks.en: Generation-chunk granularity. To determine the optimal balance between streaming latency and generation quality, we evaluate chunk sizes across 33 33 ms, 100 100 ms, and 200 200 ms. Table 8 shows that shrinking the chunk size to 33 33 ms worsens acoustic quality (FAD 3.79 3.79 ), whereas increasing it to 200 200 ms increases latency without consistent improvements across metrics. We therefore choose 100 100 ms as a practical balance between streaming granularity and generation quality.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present WorldSonus, a causal spatial audio synthesis framework for real-time sound generation in interactive world models. By factorizing generation into chunk-wise autoregressive flow matching, WorldSonus synthesizes 48 48 kHz stereo audio in 100 100 ms chunks with an execution latency of 41.2 41.2 ms per chunk on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU ( RTF = 0.41 \mathrm{RTF}=0.41 ). Our decoupled visual conditioning couples long-term planning via a bounded 5 5 s Ring-KV cache with frame-aligned local guidance in the flow head, while training-only ShiftNCE enforces precise temporal synchronization with zero inference overhead. Evaluated on open-domain videos and interactive environments, WorldSonus achieves acoustic fidelity and spatial localization competitive with or exceeding offline bidirectional models, while seamlessly supporting real-time prompt updates.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍WorldSonus,这是互动世界模型中实时声音生成的因果空间音频合成框架. WorldSonus通过将生成分解为分解自递回流匹配,将48个48克Hz的立体声合成了100ms分解,在单个NVIDIA H100 GPU(RTF=0.41\mathrm{RTF}=0.41)上执行间隔为每克41.2 41.2 ms. 我们的脱钩视觉调节夫妇通过5 5 s Ring-KV 缓存进行长期规划,流程头有相框相通的局部取向,而只有训练的ShiftNCE则以零推论高空执行精确的时间同步. 对开放域视频和互动环境进行评估后,WorldSonus实现了声学忠心和空间本地化,与离线双向模式竞争或超越,同时无缝支持实时即时更新.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: WorldSonus generates audio in the continuous latent space of a frozen causal stereo VAE adapted from SoundReactor ( Saito et al., 2025 ) . SoundReactor ( Saito et al., 2025 ) reports lower reconstruction quality for its causal VAE decoder than for its non-causal counterpart. Developing more expressive, large-scale causal audio codecs will be crucial to close this performance gap in future work.
blocks.zh: WorldSonus在由SoundReactor(Saito等,2025年)所改编的被冻结的因果立体声波(VAE)的连续潜在空间中生成音频. SoundReactor(Saito等,2025年)报告说,其因果VAE解码器的重建质量低于非因果对应器. 开发更具有表现力的大规模因果音频解码器对于弥合未来工作中的这一性能差距至关重要.

blocks.en: High-quality spatial audio data remains scarce compared to massive monophonic corpora. Many public stereo videos contain artificial or noisy channel separation that does not accurately reflect visual object motion. While our two-stage filtering pipeline and panoramic soundfield decoding extract reliable spatial supervision, expanding the scale of authentic stereo data remains a key goal for future work.
blocks.zh: 高质量的空间音频数据与大规模单声体合成体相比仍然稀缺. 许多公开的立体声视频包含人工或吵闹的频道分离,不能准确反映视觉物体运动. 虽然我们的两阶段过滤管道和全景音域解码提取出可靠的空间监督,但扩大真实立体数据的规模仍然是今后工作的一个关键目标。

blocks.en: D.4 Baseline Reproduction and Access Mode Analysis
blocks.zh: D.4 基线复制和获取模式分析

blocks.en: We compare WorldSonus against state-of-the-art bidirectional stereo models (AudioX ( Tian et al., 2025 ) , ThinkSound ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , PrismAudio ( Liu et al., 2025b ) ) and the streaming monophonic AR baseline V-AURA ( Viertola et al., 2025 ) . All baselines are evaluated using official publicly released checkpoints, default samplers, and recommended classifier-free guidance parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们把WorldSonus与最先进的双向立体模型进行比较(AudioX(天等,2025年),ThinkSound). (Liu等,2025a),PrismAudio (Liu等,2025b)和流出单声道AR基线V-AURA (Viertola等,2025.). 所有基线都使用官方公布的检查站、默认取样员以及推荐的无分级参数进行评估。

blocks.en: Baselines fall into three temporal access modes: • Bidirectional access (AudioX, ThinkSound, PrismAudio) : These models require full-clip visual context prior to inference. They process video frames via full-sequence bidirectional attention, rendering them unsuitable for streaming or live-deployment scenarios. • Stream mode (V-AURA) : For long-form generation, V-AURA operates with 640 640 ms strides over a 2.56 2.56 s visual window. Within this localized window, frame encoding via TimeSformer ( Bertasius et al., 2021 ) remains non-causal, and DAC ( Kumar et al., 2023 ) neural decoding incorporates future context. • Causal mode (WorldSonus) : Visual conditioning is limited to past and current chunk frames, maintaining strict causal alignment as detailed in Section 3 .

blocks.en: In the production stereo used in our data, channel differences do not reliably reflect physical arrival-time delays. In our diagnostic experiment, duplicating a mono signal across both channels ( L = R L=R ) achieved the lowest ITD-MSE ( Chen et al., 2022 ) among the tested outputs despite having no stereo separation. We therefore omit ITD-MSE from our spatial evaluation. We also exclude FSAD ( Sun et al., 2025a ) because it uses ITD-related StereoCRW features. Instead, we report S ​ - ​ FD O \mathrm{S\text{-}FD}_{O} and BiasSkill to evaluate stereo energy distribution and left/right channel agreement.
blocks.zh: 在我们的数据中使用的生产立体声中,信道差异并不能可靠地反映实际到达时间的延迟. 在我们的诊断实验中,跨出两个通道(L = R L = R)的单发信号在测试输出中实现了最低的IT-MSE(Chen等人,2022年),尽管没有立体分离. 因此,我们从空间评估中省略了信息技术、技术和科学司。 我们还将FSAD(Sun等,2025a)排除在外,因为它使用与IT相关的立体晶体网特征. 相反,我们报告S - FD O\mathrm{S\text{-}FD}_{O}和BiasSkill来评价立体能分布和左/右信道协议.
